label: input y fed back during the copy phase
explanation: Fires only on copy-phase steps (t > L) whose input is the token y, i.e. the model has just emitted y and it is fed back. Never fires in the original phase, at <DEL>, or on any other input token; y in the original phase does not activate it. Recall is ~100% but only about half of copy-phase y inputs activate it; the split was not captured by position (recall_idx, to_go, L, parity), the token being output, the previous token, repeat count, or first token. Activation rate rises with t. What modulates magnitude is unclear: top activations come from long sequences (L >= 7) where y is fed back in mid-to-late copy positions.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: y, k, -, g, s, 2; least: d, i, z, <DEL>) and the next token to output (most: 3, p, f, h, t, o; least: -, a, y, q); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=7, L=4 & t=7, t=17.
